The '''Nopces system''' was on the [[Mid-Core]] edge of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nopces Prime]]. The privateer ship ''[[Far Orbit]]'' once patrolled the system.
